How B100M plays

A music-driven puzzle battle. Grow a garden of light, match flowers to the beat, and send thorny seed pods to your rivals. Play the public beta at b100mgame.com.

The basics

  • Your garden rises from below. Swap two flowers side by side to line up three or more of a kind; they bloom away.
  • Flowers that fall into a new match make a chain. Chains and big combos send seed pods to a rival.
  • Clear seed pods by matching next to them; they turn back into flowers.
  • If your garden reaches the top, it's over. Stay calm, keep it low, and let the music carry you.
  • Play with a keyboard, a controller or touch. Keys and buttons can be changed in Settings.

Versus: against others

Duel

One on one. Push the Heat line into their garden.

Blackout

You against 99. Keep hot and cold in balance.

Team Blackout

Four teams of 25: seed pods go to the other teams only. The last team lit wins.

Echo Duel

Race the echo of your best win. Your chains lay shade over it.

Pruner Ladder

Eight Pruners in a row, each quicker than the last. Climb as high as you can.

Two Players

Two players, one screen: keys or controllers, hot against cold, best of three.

Garden Party

Up to four players, one garden: every chain is the team's, against a Pruner.

Online

Duel anyone online, or a friend with a four-letter code.

Live 100

Blackout with real people: you against 99 gardens, live.

Solo: on your own

Unwind

Free Garden

Set the garden up your way: columns, speed and how it rises.

Endless

No clock: the garden grows faster until it reaches the top.

One Song

Score all you can before the song ends.

Focus

Budburst

Two minutes: score all you can. A new garden for everyone every day.

Uproot

Clear down to the soil line, stage by stage, then drain the Pruner.

Pod Storm

Seed pods fall on the beat, heavier each wave. Last as long as you can.

Grow

Perennial

One year in five movements, about twelve minutes. The garden speeds up and eases like a song.

Into the Machine

Five layers, four movements each: clear the soil lines, drain the Pruner, meet the twist, then face the Pruner.

Seed Puzzles

No rise, no rival: clear the garden in a few swaps. Three new seeds every day.
